description: Search written questions (zapytania poselskie: questions from MPs to a minister on a specific, usually local or individual matter; simpler than interpellations, answered within 21 days). Returns number, title, author MP IDs, recipients, dates and replies.

delayed.description: Only questions whose answer is overdue

from.description: Only questions submitted by the MP with this ID (see get-members), e.g. 123

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; defaults to 50

modifiedSince.description: Only questions changed since this time (e.g. that received a reply), in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS format

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

since.description: Only questions sent on or after this date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. num or receiptDate; prefix with - for descending order (e.g. -receiptDate)

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

till.description: Only questions sent before this date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

title.description: Phrase to search for in the title of the question, in Polish (e.g. podatek dochodowy)

to.description: Only questions sent to this recipient, in Polish (e.g. minister zdrowia)

name: get-written-questions

answerDelayedDays.description: Days the answer is overdue (0 when answered on time)

from.description: IDs of the MPs who submitted it

num.description: Number, used by the tools that take one item

onlyAttachment.description: The reply is only in the attached PDF

prolongation.description: Notice that the answer is postponed

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: Search written questions
